objective: Apply the user-confirmed Apple/Firebase identity consistently to PlanFlow iOS source and its cloud macOS readiness workflow without committing secrets or claiming unavailable macOS/device proof.

explorer.assignment: Read-only inventory of canonical identity drift and external iOS build gates.

planner.result: The returned plan retained provisional com.planflow.app values and was not used as authority. The user-supplied Final plan and current source inventory supplied the canonical com.fluxstudio.planflow identity.

complex_implementer.result: Migrated source, validator fixtures, contracts, CI/docs and widget App Group fallback to the user-confirmed iOS identity while keeping the local Firebase plist ignored.

evidence.command: dart format --set-exit-if-changed targeted iOS contract tests
dart analyze targeted iOS contract tests
flutter test targeted iOS phase2/phase3/phase4/release/widget tests --no-pub

test_executor.external_gap: Windows has no functional bash, CocoaPods, xcodebuild or iOS build support; these outcomes are not counted as passes.

reviewer.assignment: Independent final-current-diff review with a single FINAL_REVIEW_REPORT envelope.

integrator.assignment: Reconcile scope, evidence and review without treating source readiness as macOS/device validation.

verification.source_contracts: PASS on Windows after latest contract alignment
verification.local_plist: present locally but ignored and never staged; metadata was checked without emitting contents

external_gates: Run the secret-injected Firebase validator on macOS/GitHub Actions.
Run pod install, unsigned Runner build and explicit WidgetKit target build on macOS/Xcode.
Confirm Apple App IDs and App Group linkage/signing in the developer account.
Run physical iPhone validation for runner, WidgetKit, links, notifications, maps, OAuth and ads.
